qualifications.statement: The raw OAuthUsageError property is retryAfterMs:number|null, a duration capped at24h, null for invalid/missing/non429. Later makeClaudeUsageClassificationError converts truthy duration to Date.now()+duration as metadata.retryAtMs, or undefined. Preserve these two distinct layers and serialized omission; do not port the candidate shorthand as raw retryAtMs or undefined retryAfterMs.

classifyCodexRateLimitWindows returns source window objects and does not clamp percentages. Its14 original assertions include values101/102/112/121 unchanged. Clamp/canonical-duration mapping is a separate mapper boundary. This baseline proves only the percentage projection, not complete objects/resets/credits.

Promise.all rejected cookie setup can reach finally cleanup while another cookies.set remains outstanding. Shared fixed partitions can race across calls for MiniMax and OpenCode; sequential OpenCode setup removes only the intra-call pending-set race. These are checked-source inferences, not executed race reproductions or confidentiality proof. MiniMax helper itself has no explicit proxy-setup call.

New refresh tokens returned by refreshAccessToken are not used by fetcher persistence; auth.json branch does not persist rotation. Own-credential branch uses same PID temp name and rename without explicit private mode, lock or durability guard. These source effects need separate synthetic correction fixtures.
